login.heading: Sign in

dashboard.hero_text: Check invoices, find articles and trace deliveries.
dashboard.empty: No invoices imported yet. Start with “Upload invoice”.
preview.heading: Review invoice
preview.intro_line1: Upload an INTERSPORT invoice and check the detected articles.
preview.intro_line2: The invoice and its articles are only saved to the database after you confirm.
preview.upload_hint: Up to 20 PDFs / 100 MB total · max. 20 MB and 200 pages per file. Further selections are added to the batch.
preview.batch_hint: Select, review and import invoices one at a time. Corrections are kept when switching. Previews not yet imported are discarded when you leave.
preview.ocr_notice: This invoice was read from a scanned sheet via text recognition (OCR). OCR is not 100% reliable - please check every line especially carefully before importing.
preview.positions_subheading: Search, filter or correct the detected values.
preview.edit_help: Edit fields directly in the table. Existing article master data is kept; corrected values are saved for this invoice line only.
preview.confirm_label: All lines checked – ready to import.
preview.import_all_hint: The complete invoice is always imported, even if a filter is active.
preview.errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than 20 MB.
preview.errors.duplicate_check_failed: Duplicate check failed. Please read again.
preview.errors.batch_too_large: Maximum 20 files and 100 MB per batch. Please choose a smaller batch.

preview.unsaved_edits: Unsaved corrections. Please check the changes.
preview.read_complete: Reading complete. Please review and confirm each invoice.

articles.heading: Article search
articles.intro: All articles imported so far, in one place. Search by EAN, brand or description.
articles.hint: Delivered quantities are summed per unit and do not reflect current stock. RRP: most recently recorded value by invoice date.

history.intro: All imported invoices with their original line items.
history.delete.label: Enter the invoice number to delete
history.intro.detail: Every delivery stays visible on its own, even for repeated articles within the same invoice.
